preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10³) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() and line.split()[2].isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing three space-separated integers R, C, X (2 ≤ R,C ≤ 10³, 2 ≤ X ≤ min(R,C)) representing matrix dimensions and operation window size.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == C for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+R]) and all(len(line.split()) == C for line in stdin.splitlines()[2+R:2+2*R])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the next R lines represent matrix A (R rows, C columns), followed by R lines representing matrix B (R rows, C columns).

preconditions.expression: all(all(abs(int(x)) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+R]) and all(all(abs(int(x)) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2+R:2+2*R])
preconditions.description: All elements in matrices A and B satisfy |Aᵢⱼ|, |Bᵢⱼ| ≤ 10⁹.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() in ['Yes', 'No'] for stdout in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No', indicating whether matrix A can be transformed into matrix B using the allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout == 'Yes') == (all(all((B[i][j] - A[i][j]) % d == 0 for j in range(C)) for i in range(R)) and (all(all((B[i][j] - A[i][j]) % d == 0 for i in range(R)) for j in range(C)))) for (stdout, A, B, R, C, X, d) in zip(output_lines, parsed_A, parsed_B, parsed_R, parsed_C, parsed_X, parsed_d))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'Yes' is output if and only if for every element (i,j), (Bᵢⱼ - Aᵢⱼ) is divisible by the greatest common divisor (d) of all possible differences in rows and columns, where d is the GCD of all (Bᵢⱼ - Aᵢⱼ) for all i,j, and the differences in each row and column can be expressed as linear combinations of operations of size X.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout == 'No') == (any(all((B[i][j] - A[i][j]) % d != 0 for j in range(C)) for i in range(R)) or any(all((B[i][j] - A[i][j]) % d != 0 for i in range(R)) for j in range(C))) for (stdout, A, B, R, C, X, d) in zip(output_lines, parsed_A, parsed_B, parsed_R, parsed_C, parsed_X, parsed_d))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'No' is output if there exists at least one row or column where the differences (Bᵢⱼ - Aᵢⱼ) are not all divisible by the GCD of all differences, making transformation impossible.
